name: Password Strength Meter
summary: Check password strength with entropy, checks, and tips — nothing leaves your browser.
description: Type or paste a password to see a strength score, estimated entropy, character-class checks, and improvement tips. Detects common passwords and long repeated character runs. Educational heuristic — not a live breach lookup.

faqs.question: Is my password uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Analysis runs entirely in your browser and is never sent to a server.

faqs.question: Does this check Have I Been Pwned?
faqs.answer: No. It is a local heuristic (length, character classes, common patterns). It does not query breach databases.

faqs.question: What does entropy mean here?
faqs.answer: An estimate of length × log2(detected character-set size). Higher is generally harder to brute-force, but real-world security also depends on uniqueness.

faqs.question: Need a new password?
faqs.answer: Use Forge’s Random Password Generator for CSPRNG-based passwords.
